full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff respondent opposite party filed a suit for declaration of easement right and permanent injunction being title suit No.190 of 1.9.89 which on transfer was registered as title suit No.138 of 1991 in the Court of Additional Assistant Judge, Dhaka. The suit was ultimately decreed by the trial court. The defendant petitioner along with other defendants contested the suit by filing a written statement denying the plaintiffs allegation and asserting that plaintiff has no easement right in the land of the defendant no.5. Ultimately the suit was tried by the 3rd Additional Assistant Judge, Dhaka who by his judgment and decree dated was pleased to decree the suit. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and decree passed by the learned 3rd Additional Assistant Judge in Title Suit No.38 of 1991 the defendant petitioner preferred an appeal before the District Judge which was registered as Title Appeal No.347 of 1991 and the said appeal has been transferred to the court of the 1st Additional District Judge, Dhaka where the appeal is still pending.
